speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss. Can you describe the nature of your abdominal pain, such as its location and severity, and how long these symptoms have been present?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any trouble swallowing or have you noticed any lumps in your neck or under your arms? I also need to know if you have experienced any fevers or itching, and whether you smoke or drink alcohol regularly.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: CT Scan Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis. I also need a biopsy of the supraclavicular lymph node to determine the cellular origin of these symptoms.

text: RESULTS: CT Scan Thorax and Abdomen: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes. Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index, combined with your B-symptoms and widespread lymphadenopathy, strongly indicate a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma. I will request further staging tests to confirm the extent of the disease before starting treatment. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal bone marrow biopsy confirms that the disease has not spread to the marrow, which helps in staging. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
